hero.title: CAFÉ & BAR
hero.subtitle: A café that dares to do cocktails, a bar that respects coffee. In the heart of Clermont-Ferrand, we don't choose.

ambiance.title: The Atmosphere

r1.text: Great atmosphere, the specialty coffee is incredible and the place is beautiful.

r2.name: Julien T.
r2.text: The best spot in Clermont for a drink with friends. Fantastic team!

r3.name: Camille L.
r3.text: Beautiful decor and signature cocktails to die for. Highly recommend.
